Research spans geospatial data science, climate adaptation and migration, participatory GIS, conservation, environmental perception, urban change, and AI-enabled spatial analysis.

- **Estabrook, T., Van Berkel, D., Jorns, J., & Lemos, M.C. (2026).** *Exploring climate-induced migration impacts on urban growth.* Computers, Environment and Urban Systems 123, 102368.
- **Song, Y., Millard-Ball, A., Fox, N., Van Berkel, D., Agrawal, A., & Zhu, K. (2026).** *Political ideology and scientific communication shape human perceptions of pollen seasons.* PNAS Nexus 5(1), pgaf386.
- **Yang, X., Tian, A., Van Berkel, D., Qiang, X., & Lindquist, M. (2026).** *Can Urban Blight Be Accessed with Vision-language Models: A Case Study in Detroit.* arXiv:2608.01753.
- **Li, Z., Van Berkel, D., Hasell, A., Schoenebeck, G., Ryan, J.B., & Tomkins, S. (2026).** *AnnotateThis: Analyzing a human-LLM system for annotating social media data with the concept of climate change mitigation pessimism.* arXiv:2606.10210.
- **Lemos, M.C. et al. (2025).** *Scaling up actionable climate knowledge.* Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences 122(50), e2515771122.
